relationships.subject: Gua Sha
relationships.evidence_quote: Gua Sha can improve hypoxia in the DRG and suppress HIF-1α and its downstream factors, reducing LA while promoting ATP production.

key_findings: Gua Sha relieved DRG hypoxia and reduced HIF-1α, GLUT1, PDK1, PFKM, lactate and DRG inflammatory factors in radiculitis rats, improving pain thresholds.
The HIF-1α activator DMOG reversed Gua Sha effects, supporting HIF-1α-mediated metabolic reprogramming as a pathogenic mechanism in radiculitis-induced pain.
